title: migrate OkHttp2 to OkHttp3
symptom: Some classes still using com.squareup.okhttp (v2.x) which is deprecated since 2016, while many others use the newer v3.x. Using both major versions within a project can cause strange problems.
cause: The codebase contains a mix of OkHttp 2.x and 3.x dependencies, which can lead to conflicts.
fix: Migrate the code using the deprecated version to v3. Best practice is to create a single OkHttpClient instance and share it throughout the application, using OkHttpClient.newBuilder() for customization.
evidence_quote: We should migrate the code using the deprecated version to v3.
